title: Token to Goal: 3 by 3 Grid Puzzle
description: A 3 by 3 board of grey tiles seen from above and in front. A blue sphere token starts on the bottom-left square; a raised orange disc labelled Goal sits on the top-right square. Up, Down, Left and Right buttons move the token one square. Hint shows a yellow arrow from the token pointing along a move that brings it one step closer to the goal. Readouts give moves made and steps still to the goal.

game.objective: Move the token from the bottom-left square to the marked goal square in the top-right corner.
game.hint: Steps to goal = rows apart + columns apart. Every move that lowers it is on a shortest route; the best is 4 moves.

assumptions: This is a simple made-up puzzle, not a model of anything real.
The token moves only up, down, left or right, never diagonally, so 'steps to goal' counts the up/down steps plus the left/right steps (taxicab distance).
The token starts on the bottom-left square and the goal is the top-right square, so the shortest route takes 4 moves.
Once the token reaches the goal, the game is won and the move buttons stop working until you press Reset.
A move off the board does nothing and is not counted. The hint arrow stays until your next move.
